Double Observer Adjusted Survey (DOAS) Abundance Estimation

Source: R/doas.R
doas.Rd

Estimates total population abundance using either a full Double Observer (DO) survey across all sectors or a partial Double Observer Adjusted Survey (DOAS) combining DO surveys in a subset of sectors with single-observer block counts (and optionally unsurveyed sectors imputed via n_formula). Supports both Frequentist and multi-chain Bayesian MCMC inference across independent (Lincoln-Petersen/Chapman) and dependent (2-pass removal/Zippin) double-observer field protocols.

Usage

doas(
  data,
  method = c("ML", "Bayes", "frequentist", "bayesian"),
  obs_type = c("independent", "dependent"),
  pooling = c("hybrid", "global"),
  p_formula = NULL,
  n_formula = NULL,
  ci_method = c("lognormal", "bootstrap"),
  R = 1000,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 2000,
  burnin = NULL
)

# S3 method for class 'doas'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

data

A dataframe or doas_data object containing survey data. Each row represents a sector: - sector_id: Unique identifier for the sector. - total_count: Total individuals counted across all groups in the sector (NA if unsurveyed). - detected_groups: Total groups detected in the sector. - groups_both, groups_obs1, groups_obs2: Double Observer group counts (non-NA for DO sectors, NA for Block/Unsurveyed sectors).

method

Character string specifying the statistical inference paradigm: - "ML" (default): Uses Maximum Likelihood / analytical Chapman (when obs_type = "independent") or Zippin removal (when obs_type = "dependent") estimators and Delta-method variance. Also accepts "frequentist". - "Bayes": Uses a multi-chain Collapsed Poisson-Gamma-Beta Gibbs Sampler (MCMC) to sample the full joint posterior of detection probabilities and abundance. Also accepts "bayesian".

obs_type

Character string specifying the field observer protocol: - "independent" (default): Both observers scan independently (Lincoln-Petersen / Chapman geometry). - "dependent": Primary observer calls out detected groups and Secondary observer records only missed groups (2-pass removal / Zippin geometry).

pooling

Character string specifying how DO sector estimates are combined with Block sectors: - "hybrid" (default): Uses sector-specific DO estimates for DO sectors and extrapolates only Block sectors using the pooled/modeled detection probability. - "global": Extrapolates all surveyed sectors using the pooled or covariate-modeled detection probability.

p_formula

Optional one-sided formula (e.g., ~ effort * ruggedness) to model detection probability \(\hat{p}\) across sectors. For method = "ML", fits a quasi-binomial GLM; for method = "Bayes", runs a coupled multi-chain Bayesian logistic regression via MCMC.

n_formula

Optional one-sided formula (e.g., ~ elevation + habitat + offset(log(area))) to model sector-level abundance \(\lambda_i\) as a function of environmental covariates (Quasi-Poisson log-link GLM in ML mode; Bayesian Poisson log-linear regression in Bayes mode). Enables predict.doas for new/unsurveyed sectors and habitat response curves.

ci_method

Character string specifying how to calculate Confidence/Credible Intervals: - "lognormal" (default): Uses the analytic Chao (1987) log-normal approximation for ML estimators, or direct posterior credible intervals from the MCMC draws when method = "Bayes". - "bootstrap": Uses a non-parametric stratified sector resampling bootstrap.

R

Integer indicating the number of bootstrap replicates (only used if ci_method = "bootstrap"). Default is 1000.

chains

Integer number of Markov chains when method = "Bayes" (default 4).

iter

Integer number of total MCMC iterations per chain when method = "Bayes" (default 2000).

burnin

Integer number of warm-up/burn-in iterations per chain when method = "Bayes" (default floor(iter / 4)).

object

An object of class `doas`

...

Additional arguments

Value

A list of class `doas` containing the estimate, confidence/credible intervals, sector-level estimates, fitted submodels, and (when Bayes) MCMC convergence diagnostics.
